meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Azure 上规划部署或检查资源限制。
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan deployments or check resource limits on Azure.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询和管理 Azure 订阅中的配额（服务限制）和当前使用量，包括检查特定资源的可用容量、比较不同区域的配额、以及提交配额增加请求。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Azure 配额、服务限制、当前使用量、配额增加请求、容量验证或区域选择时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下美国东部区域的 vCPU 配额和使用情况。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本返回配额、使用量和可用容量。

say.text: 申请将 eastus 的 Standard Dsv3 系列配额增加到 500。
say.note: Claude 会提交配额增加请求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query and manage Azure quotas (service limits) and current usage across subscriptions, including checking available capacity for specific resources, comparing quotas across regions, and submitting quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about Azure quotas, service limits, current usage, quota increase requests, capacity validation, or region selection.

say_en.text: Check vCPU quota and usage in East US region.
say_en.note: Claude runs the script to return limits, usage, and available capacity.

say_en.text: Compare Standard Dsv3 family vCPU quotas between eastus and westus2.
say_en.note: Claude compares available capacity across regions.

say_en.text: Request to increase Standard Dsv3 family quota to 500 in eastus.
say_en.note: Claude submits a quota increase request.
